aiPluginUtterances.utterance: Give me the top 5 accounts based on revenue

GenAiPlugin.description: This topic handles summarizing account information for users. It includes providing details on account status, recent activity, and other relevant account data.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Gather necessary information from the user to accurately summarize the account.
When summarizing the account, include details such as account balance, recent transactions, and any pending actions.
If the user has specific questions about their account, address those within the scope of summarizing the account.
If a user requests an account summary, provide an overview of the account status and recent activity.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to summarize account information based on user requests. You should not make any changes to the account or handle unrelated inquiries.
